attributes.board_name: North Dakota State Board of Pharmacy

rules.new_licensee_rule: Not required for the first renewal of a registration.
rules.carryover: No carryover, except hours earned in the 12 months before a reporting period may count in either period (not both).
rules.alternatives: Board may grant a waiver. Inactive technicians need no CE; reactivation needs 10 hours or current national certification.
rules.audit_note: Keep own records 2 years; proof on board request. Missing hours may mean suspension.
rules.notes: Annual registration; CE reporting period March 1-end of February. Half of the $35 fee goes to the Northland Association of Pharmacy Technicians.
